required_outcomes: Notices that the email asking the landlord how she wants the repair handled (event 003) was never delivered, so the landlord has not been asked yet and no answer is pending from her.

Contacts the landlord by a different channel from her record (phone or SMS, or a corrected email address if one is on file) with the same direct question: arrange the shower repair herself, or have the agency organise it; does not simply resend to the address that bounced.
Replies to the tenant with an honest status: the landlord is being contacted to approve the repair and no contractor or visit date is booked yet.
acceptable_alternatives: Retrying the email once in addition to an SMS or phone attempt, provided another channel is used as well.
Asking the tenant for the photos again in the same reply, as long as the repair is not made to wait for them.
positive_behaviours: Sets a follow-up within one working day, noting that 29 March and 1 April 2024 are bank holidays.
Gives the tenant simple advice to limit the leak (avoid using the shower, check for an isolation valve on the shower supply, keep water off the floor).
Records in the case that the landlord email bounced, so the mailbox problem is fixed on the landlord record.
red_flags: Treating the case as waiting for a landlord reply that cannot come, and leaving it on hold.
Telling the tenant the landlord has been asked or is considering it when the only request bounced.
prohibited_actions: Assigning or instructing a contractor before the landlord has answered.
Telling the tenant a contractor is booked or giving her a visit date.
critical_failures: Resending the request only to the email address that bounced, or doing nothing, so the landlord is still not asked.
